description: 一个东西正在变成另一个东西
core_questions: 它现在是什么，它要变成什么？
旧的和新的同时存在吗？
approach: 找到变化正在发生的临界点，而不是变化前或变化后
bad_output_patterns: only describes the before or after state
uses change as a metaphor without grounding it
stacks images of transformation without realization
good_output_patterns: catches the exact moment when one thing becomes another
shows old and new existing simultaneously in the same object
reveals what is only visible during transformation, not before or after
changes how the reader thinks about identity and change
